title: Blok document
description: A saved Blok document: a flat array of blocks. Nesting is expressed by references — a child carries `parent`, its container carries `content` — never by nesting blocks inside each other.

id.description: The document id. Blok writes it on the first save and keeps it.

time.description: Unix epoch milliseconds when the document was saved.

version.description: Version of Blok that produced the document.

title.description: The page title. Absent when empty.

icon.description: The page icon. Absent when none. The editor ignores a malformed icon when it loads one; this schema rejects it. Extra keys are allowed, because the editor keeps them.

blocks.description: Every block in the document, in reading order.

id.description: Unique block id. Generated on load when absent.

type.description: Registered tool name. Built-in names are covered by $defs; custom tools are allowed.

data.description: Tool-specific payload. See the $defs entry matching `type`.

tunes.description: Per-tune payloads, keyed by tune name. Unknown tunes are preserved as-is.

parent.description: Id of the containing block. Absent for a root-level block.

content.description: Ids of this block's children, in order. Absent when it has none.

lastEditedAt.description: Unix epoch milliseconds of the last edit to this block.

lastEditedBy.description: Identifier of the user who last edited this block.

oneOf.description: Rich-text segments, in order. Preferred: this is the shape Blok saves.

marks.description: Formatting on one run. Unknown keys are dropped, except custom `tag:<name>` marks.

sup.description: Not with sub on one run: sup wins.

color.description: "gray", "brown", "orange", "yellow", "green", "blue", "purple", "pink", "red". A hex, rgb or hsl value is stored as the nearest of them. A non-colour is dropped.

background.description: Like color. White and transparent are dropped.

link.description: Missing target and rel get the Link tool's defaults.

html.description: Inline markup with no segment shape, kept verbatim.

table.description: A grid whose cells reference child blocks by id; the referenced blocks are siblings in `blocks` carrying `parent` = the table id.

withHeadings.description: First row is a heading row.

withHeadingColumn.description: First column is a heading column.

stretched.description: Table spans the full editor width.

anyOf.description: Legacy plain-text cell, still accepted on load.

blocks.description: Ids of the blocks rendered in this cell, in order.

id.description: Column id. Every cell of one column carries the same value.

rowId.description: Row id. Every cell of one row carries the same value.

text.description: Inline HTML mirror of the cell, kept for import/export paths.

colspan.description: Only set on a merge origin.

rowspan.description: Only set on a merge origin.

mergedInto.description: [row, col] of the merge origin covering this cell.

colWidths.description: Column widths in pixels. Omit for equal widths.

initialColWidth.description: Per-column width in pixels captured at creation.

toggle.description: A collapsible summary line. Its body blocks reference it as `parent`.

isOpen.description: Ignored. Open state is personal and never saved.

callout.description: A highlighted panel. Its body blocks reference it as `parent`; the panel itself holds no text.

emoji.description: Leading emoji. Empty string hides it.

textColor.description: Preset name, or null to inherit.

backgroundColor.description: Preset name, or null for none.

database.description: Schema and view configuration only — rows are child `database-row` blocks.

source.description: A linked database: shows the rows and schema of this database block. Its own schema is a stand-in for older readers.

documentId.description: A database in another document, read through the host.

activeViewId.description: Id of the view shown by default.

hideDataSourceTitles.description: Hides the title line above the tabs for every view. Default false.

icon.description: The icon before the title: one of Blok's glyphs on a tinted tile.

starter.description: The template this database was made from. Removed by "Undo … database".

value.description: The literal property value to write.

schema.description: Column definitions. Exactly one must have type "title".

databaseLocked.description: Read on the title property only: locks the schema and views. Data entry still works.

defaultTemplateId.description: Read on the title property only: the template row new rows start from.

pageLayoutStructure.description: Read on the title property only: the row page structure. Default simple.

pageLayoutGroupIn.description: Read on the title property only: where the row page property group sits. Default page.

pageLayoutPropertyIcons.description: Read on the title property only: false hides the icon beside each row page property label. Absent means shown.

pageLayoutPropertyLabels.description: Read on the title property only: false hides the property labels in the row page heading. Absent means shown.

pageLayoutTemplates.description: Read on the title property only: false hides the database templates on an empty row page. Absent means shown.

pageLayoutFullWidth.description: Read on the title property only: true lays every row page out full width. Absent means off.

pageLayoutTabsId.description: Read on the title property only: id of the tabs child of this database that holds the row page view tabs (first tab is Content; each other tab holds one linked database). Kept while Simple. Absent means none yet. A tab or tabs child carrying `draft` is someone's unapplied layout draft, not part of the layout.

pageLayoutPlacements.description: Read on the title property only: where properties sit on the row page. A property with no entry sits in the property group.

place.description: heading pins it under the title; page and panel give it a module of its own; group keeps it in the property group, ahead of the properties with no entry.

sectionId.description: With place "section": the section it sits in.

pageLayoutSections.description: Read on the title property only: named sections of the row page property group.

config.description: Type-specific options; select/multiSelect carry their choices here.

groupId.description: Status only: the id of the status group holding this option.

pageVisibility.description: How the row page shows the property. Default always.

date.description: Display of date, created time and last edited time values.

timeZone.description: IANA zone. Absent means the viewer's zone.

defaultReminder.description: Notifications: the reminder a date set afterwards in an empty cell starts with. Existing reminders stay.

defaultOptionId.description: The option id a new row starts with.

person.description: Person options. Blok sends no notifications: it only stores the choice for the host.

limit.description: 1 keeps one person. Absent or null means no limit.

default.description: createdBy: a new row starts with the user who adds it.

expression.description: Formulas 2.0 source. prop("Name") is stored as {{property:<id>}}, so a rename keeps working.

relation.description: Values are id objects of rows of the target database: [{ "id": "<row block id>" }].

targetDatabaseId.description: A database block in this document. The database's own id makes a self-relation.

targetDocumentId.description: A database in another document, resolved by the host.

limit.description: 1 keeps one related row. Absent or null means no limit.

syncedPropertyId.description: Two-way: the mirroring property on the target database.

role.description: A self-relation that drives sub-items (parentItem/subItems) or dependencies (blockedBy/blocking).

autofill.description: AI autofill. Blok has no AI: the host config.ai.autofill lever fills the value.

language.description: Translate: the target language, a BCP 47 tag.

onCreate.description: Fill when a row is added. Default false.

onEdit.description: Fill again when another value of the row changes. Default false.

onEditProperties.description: With onEdit: only a change to one of these property ids fills again. Absent means any property.

onEditContent.description: Fill again when the row's page body is edited here (never a peer, undo or redo). Default false.

targetPropertyId.description: A property of the related database.

buttonActions.description: Run in order on a click, as one undo step.

value.description: editProperty: the new value. [{ "id": "@me" }] and "@today" are filled in on click.

databaseId.description: addPage: the database block the page goes into. Absent: this database.

edits.description: addPage and editPages: the values the page gets, filled in on click like an editProperty value.

target.description: editPages: thisPage, the page an earlier addPage step added, or the pages of a database that match both filter lists (none: every page). Absent: edits nothing.

filters.description: Same shape as a view filter.

filterTree.description: Same shape as a view filterTree.

stepId.description: openPage: open the page an earlier addPage action added. Wins over url.

message.description: showConfirmation: the question. sendNotification: the message.

cancelLabel.description: showConfirmation: the Cancel button text. Cancel stops this action and every one after it.

variables.description: defineVariables: stored only; no action field reads them yet.

recipients.description: sendNotification: up to 20 people, or the people in a person property of the row. The host sends it (config.buttons.onNotify).

blocks.description: insertBlocks: added at the end of the row page body.

url.description: openPage: a URL. Absent opens the row page.

name.description: callback: what the host should do. addPage: the new page name; empty shows "Untitled".

dependency.description: Read on the blockedBy relation only.

shift.description: How a date change moves blocked items. Default none.

groupBy.description: Property id. Required for a board view.

groupByStatus.description: Grouping by a status: one group per status group or per option. Default option.

operator.description: Notion API operator. Dates add past_week, next_month, this_week, relative_to_today and others.

value.description: Any property value; shape follows the property type.

visibleProperties.description: Visible non-title property ids, in order. Kept in step with `properties` for older readers.

properties.description: Per-property settings in this view; array order is column order. Wins over visibleProperties.

required.description: Form: the question must be answered.

description.description: Form: help text under the question.

questionName.description: Form: a detached question label; absent follows the property name.

longAnswer.description: Form: a multi-line text answer; absent means a one-line answer.

maxSelections.description: Form: maximum multi-select, people or relation selections.

showOptionsAs.description: Form: how a choice question lists its options; absent is list for multi-select, dropdown for select and status.

wrapCells.description: Wrap every cell. Default true for a table, false otherwise.

frozenColumnCount.description: Columns from the start that stay put on horizontal scroll. Default 0.

capCounts.description: Show a count above 99 as "99+". Default false.

openPagesIn.description: Where a row page opens. Default side; center for gallery and calendar.

cardSize.description: Gallery or board card size. Default medium.

cardPreview.description: What a gallery or board card shows above its title: none, the page cover, the page content, or "property:<id>". Default content on a gallery, none on a board.

fitImage.description: Gallery or board: show the whole image instead of cropping it. Default false.

cardLayout.description: Board: list puts each card property on its own line, compact sets them side by side. Default list.

calendarBy.description: Calendar: the date property id that places each row. Default the first date property.

timelineBy.description: Timeline: the date property id that places each bar. Default the first date property.

timelineEndBy.description: Timeline: a second date property id that ends each bar. Absent means timelineBy holds the range.

timelineCenter.description: Timeline: the shared centre day (YYYY-MM-DD). A person's own last centre wins over it.

showTimelineTable.description: Timeline: show the table panel. Default false.

tableProperties.description: Timeline table panel columns, apart from the bar properties; array order is column order.

arrowsBy.description: Timeline: the self-relation property id that draws dependency arrows.

chartType.description: Chart: the chart type. The X axis (donut: each slice) is groupBy; the series are subGroupBy. Default column.

chartMeasure.description: Chart: the Y axis, "count" or "<calculation>:<property id>" such as "sum:p1". Default count.

chartSort.description: Chart: bar order. Default manual (the group order).

chartOmitZero.description: Chart: drop groups whose value is zero. Default false.

chartCumulative.description: Chart: running total. Applies only to count or sum with chartSort xAscending. Default false.

chartAxisNames.description: Chart: show axis names. Default false.

chartDataLabels.description: Chart: show a value on each bar, point or slice. Default false.

chartSmooth.description: Line chart: smooth curve. Default false.

chartGradient.description: Line chart: shade the area under the line. Default false.

chartCenterValue.description: Donut chart: show the total in the center. Default true.

noValueGroupPosition.description: Where the no-value group sits among the groups. Absent means last.

groupOrder.description: This view's own manual group order: option id to a fractional key, compared with option positions. An option without a key uses its position.

capCounts.description: Show a count above 99 as "99+". Default false.

groupCalculation.description: Board: the calculation beside every group name. Absent means count all rows, shown as "99+" above 99. fn count is saved only to keep that cap off.

value.description: Any property value; shape follows the property type. A relation filter may hold "this_page": the row page the view is shown on (no row page: matches nothing).
Any property value; shape follows the property type. A relation filter may hold "this_page": the row page the view is shown on (no row page: matches nothing).
Any property value; shape follows the property type. A relation filter may hold "this_page": the row page the view is shown on (no row page: matches nothing).

filterTree.description: Advanced filter. Rows must match it and every simple filter. Older clients ignore it.

subGroupBy.description: Board only: property id of a second grouping inside each column. Its keys in hiddenGroups/collapsedGroups start with "sub:".

colorRules.description: Conditional color. The first matching rule colors a row.

value.description: Any property value; shape follows the property type.

showDataSourceTitle.description: Linked views only: show the source title. Default true.

subItemsDisplay.description: Sub-items: nested (table, list, timeline) or card (board, calendar, gallery) by default, or flattened.

subItemsFilter.description: Sub-items: which rows show. Default parents.

rowOrder.description: This view's own manual order: row id to a fractional key, compared with row positions. A row without a key uses its position. Absent: the shared order.

form.description: Form view settings. The public link is the host's.

closed.description: The form takes no answers. Default false.

anonymous.description: Answers carry no respondent. Default false.

public.description: Anyone on the web with the link can fill it out. Default false: workspace members only.

submissionAccess.description: What a respondent may do with the page their answer becomes. Default none.

mapBy.description: Map: the place property id. Default the first place property.

mapHeight.description: Map height: 300, 400, 600 or 800 px. Default medium.

dashboard.description: Dashboard slot. Blok draws no dashboard yet.

databaseId.description: The database holding the view. Omit for this database.

calendarSync.description: Calendar sync slot, for the host. Blok syncs nothing.

dataSourceId.description: Multi-source slot: the database block whose rows this view shows. Absent means this database. Blok reads only its own rows yet.

database-row.description: One row of a database block. Optional pageId points to a separate body document.

^reactions:.description: One person's feed reactions; the key is "reactions:" plus their user id. Emoji to when they reacted (epoch ms).

properties.description: Column values keyed by property id. Values follow the parent database's schema, so the shape is open.

title.description: Row title, mirrored from the title column. Absent on rows written before this key existed.

pageId.description: Id of the separate document that holds the row page body.

bodyBlocks.description: True once the page body lives in the row's child blocks. A legacy body blob in a richText property is then ignored.

icon.description: The row page icon, an emoji.

cover.description: The row page cover, an image URL.

fullWidth.description: The row page's own Full width. Absent: the database page layout decides. Only a full page widens.

template.description: A page template, not a row. Views and exports skip it.

anonymous.description: An anonymous form answer: saved with no createdBy; Created by reads "Anonymous".

repeat.description: Templates only: a repeating schedule. The host runs it.

timeZone.description: IANA zone whose wall clock the runs keep across DST. Absent: UTC.

start.description: ISO date-time of the first run.

weekdays.description: Weekly only: days it runs on, 1 = Monday … 7 = Sunday, each at the start's time. Absent: the start's weekday.

end.description: ISO date-time after which it makes no more rows. Absent: never.

reminders.description: Date reminders keyed by date property id. The host sends them through config.reminders.onReminderDue.

remind.description: When to remind. The day offsets remind at 9:00; minutes and hours count back from a timed date.

timeZone.description: IANA zone of whoever set the reminder. A date with no property time zone is due in it, so every client agrees. Absent: each viewer's zone.

sentFor.description: The due time (ISO) the host last sent. Not offered again while it equals the current due time.

convertedValues.description: Values a property type change could not carry over, keyed by property id; restored if the type changes back.

value.description: The value as the old type stored it.

database-comment.description: One comment on a database row. A thread is a comment under the row; its replies are its children. Not page content: views and exports skip it.

createdAt.description: Epoch ms when it was written.

authorId.description: The writer, as the host knows people. Absent without a host directory.

authorName.description: The writer's display name when it was written. Absent for an anonymous writer.

propertyId.description: Set on a thread about one cell: that property's id.

editedAt.description: Epoch ms of the last edit.

divider.description: A horizontal rule. Carries no data.

height.description: Gap in pixels. Defaults to 38; out-of-range values are clamped on load.

table_of_contents.description: An outline of the page headings. The list is read from the document each time and never saved.

oneOf.description: Rich-text segments, in order. Preferred: this is the shape Blok saves.

marks.description: Formatting on one run. Unknown keys are dropped, except custom `tag:<name>` marks.

sup.description: Not with sub on one run: sup wins.

color.description: "gray", "brown", "orange", "yellow", "green", "blue", "purple", "pink", "red". A hex, rgb or hsl value is stored as the nearest of them. A non-colour is dropped.

background.description: Like color. White and transparent are dropped.

link.description: Missing target and rel get the Link tool's defaults.

html.description: Inline markup with no segment shape, kept verbatim.

link.description: Missing target and rel get the Link tool's defaults.

oneOf.description: Plain text: HTML tags stay literal. Use segments for formatting. Saved data from older documents may hold inline HTML here.

code.description: A code block. `code` is raw text, never HTML.

filename.description: File name shown above the code, e.g. "block.ts". Omitted when empty.

variants.description: Every rendition, best format first. Ignored unless it contains `url`, the most compatible one.

naturalWidth.description: Intrinsic pixel width, cached after first load.

crop.description: Non-destructive crop, in percent of the intrinsic image. Omitted for an uncropped rectangle. With `rotation`, `flipX` or `straighten` set, it is in percent of the turned image's box.

rotation.description: Clockwise quarter turn, applied after the mirror. Omitted for 0.

flipX.description: Mirror left to right, before the turn. Omitted for false.

straighten.description: Clockwise degrees, after the turn. Omitted for 0.

filter.description: Colour look: a built-in preset (vivid, noir, sepia, …) or a host filter name from the image tool's `filters` config. Omitted for "none".

filterStrength.description: How strongly `filter` applies. Omitted for 100 and when there is no filter.

adjust.description: Colour adjustments, each -100..100. Zero entries are omitted, and so is an empty object.

markup.description: Drawings, shapes and text over the image, back to front. Omitted when empty. Coordinates are fractions (0..1) of the turned image's box, before crop and straighten. Sizes are fractions of that box's shorter side.

points.description: Flat x, y, pressure triples. Pressure is 0..1.

cut.description: Ends the eraser cut. Omitted when none.

anyOf.description: A shape between two corners. Rect and ellipse fill the box they span; line and arrow join the points.

fill.description: Rect and ellipse only: a translucent fill. Omitted for false.

rotation.description: Star and polygon only: clockwise degrees. Omitted for 0.

tx.description: Bubble only: where the tail points.

text.description: Plain text; a newline breaks the line.

rotation.description: Clockwise degrees about the centre. Omitted for 0.

variants.description: Every rendition, best format first. Ignored unless it contains `url`, the most compatible one.

column_list.description: A row of columns. Carries no data — the columns are its `content` children.

column.description: One column of a column_list. Its content is its `content` children.

widthRatio.description: Width relative to sibling columns. Omitted for an even split.

tabs.description: A set of tabs. Carries no data except a database's draft mark — the tabs are its `content` children, which are only `tab` blocks. The open tab is not saved.

draft.description: Set by a database's Customize layout on a row-page view tab not applied yet. Other editors hide it; Apply removes it. Never write it.

at.description: Epoch ms when it was made.

by.description: The maker's collaboration client ids; empty without collaboration.

tab.description: One tab of a tabs block. Its content is its `content` children.

title.description: Plain text, not HTML. Empty for an untitled tab.

icon.description: Emoji shown before the title. Omitted when the tab has none.

draft.description: Set by a database's Customize layout on a row-page view tab not applied yet. Other editors hide it; Apply removes it. Never write it.

at.description: Epoch ms when it was made.

by.description: The maker's collaboration client ids; empty without collaboration.

embed.description: A live third-party embed. Only registry-matched provider URLs are embedded.
Provider-sanctioned embed URL. Must be https.

bookmark.description: A static link preview card built from OpenGraph metadata.

page.description: A link to a sub-page. The page body lives in a separate document named by `pageId`, not in this one, so the block has no children.

pageId.description: Id of the separate document that holds the page.

page-link.description: A non-owning reference to a page. It has no children.
